advice_items.quote: even when I was really doing well making tens of millions of dollars I was very very cash poor... I made $10 million I'm balling no I'm not I got bills like big bills
advice_items.summary_en: Understand cash flow and obligations—high revenue does not mean you are cash-rich.
advice_items.summary_zh: 营收高不代表现金充裕，需警惕大额账单

advice_items.quote: sales cures everything... sales persuasion influence the mastering the art of copywriting if you can sell well you can sell your way out of any challenge
advice_items.summary_en: Master sales, persuasion, and copywriting so you can sell your way out of any crisis.
advice_items.summary_zh: 磨练销售与说服力，销出一切困境

advice_items.quote: winners have a bounceback spirit... I'm going to rally the team we're going to fight like hell
advice_items.summary_en: Cultivate a bounce-back spirit and rally your team to fight through crises.
advice_items.summary_zh: 拥有反弹精神，带领团队奋力拼搏

advice_items.quote: look at the single tenant triple net lease game... it's easier to do a $50 million commercial deal than a $1 million house flip the financing is easier the people involved are smarter
advice_items.summary_en: Invest in single-tenant triple-net commercial real estate; larger deals have easier financing and smarter counterparties.
advice_items.summary_zh: 切入三净租约商业地产，大额交易更易融资

advice_items.quote: I fired myself I got the hell out of the way... form this amazing team and get the hell out of the way
advice_items.summary_en: Build an elite team, fire yourself from daily operations, and get out of the way to scale.
advice_items.summary_zh: 组建顶尖团队并果断退位放权

advice_items.quote: money love speed cut the check
advice_items.summary_en: Move fast and execute decisively because money rewards speed.
advice_items.summary_zh: 金钱喜欢速度，果断决策立即行动

advice_items.quote: it's not going to happen on your time frame it's much more difficult than you think and if you're a mental [__] it's not for you bow out now
advice_items.summary_en: Do not expect overnight results on your own timeline; business is far harder than expected.
advice_items.summary_zh: 创业远比想象艰难，不急于求成者方能胜出

guests.first_money_or_break: 早年靠街头智慧白手起家，曾面临55万美元信用卡账单与20多万美元薪资的现金流危机，靠一周半卖出80万美元新产品渡过难关。
recommended_books_or_mentors: Early mentor (who taught him 'sales cures everything')
guests.role_or_title: Multi-Business Owner & Commercial Real Estate Investor
guests.wealth_detail: Owns ~4 eight-figure businesses; has made tens of millions of dollars
guests.zero_start_advice: 从单租户三净租约（NNN）商业地产入手（规模越大融资越容易）；磨练销售、说服力与文案写作能力；组建优秀团队并果断放权退出日常执行。

advice_items.quote: I have a garage door company called A1 Garage Door Service so blue collar home service industry best decision I've ever made... good things come to those who wait
advice_items.summary_en: Build a blue-collar home service business and commit to it for the long haul.
advice_items.summary_zh: 深耕蓝领家居服务等传统现金流行业

advice_items.quote: we'll do $240 million this year you know we're over 20% on the bottom line so remember this revenue is for vanity profit is for sanity we run a lot of efficiency
advice_items.summary_en: Prioritize bottom-line profit over vanity revenue through operational efficiency and economies of scale.
advice_items.summary_zh: 营收虚荣利润才真实，靠规模降本增效

advice_items.quote: here's the book you should read... The E-Myth Revisited Think and Grow Rich by Napoleon Hill Dale Carnegie... Dan Martell Buy Back Your Time
advice_items.summary_en: Read foundational business and time-leverage books like The E-Myth Revisited and Buy Back Your Time.
advice_items.summary_zh: 持续阅读商业经典书籍迭代认知

advice_items.quote: studying where your time's going and how much waste we have... if you could buy back your time and look at efficiency I think you could really scale
advice_items.summary_en: Audit and eliminate time-wasters like endless phone scrolling so you can buy back and compound your time.
advice_items.summary_zh: 戒掉无意义刷手机，买回并复利时间

advice_items.quote: billionaires are much better at not working... they know who to call when... I'm calling the best and they're not cheap... I need these results more than I need a deal
advice_items.summary_en: Instead of doing everything or haggling on price, hire the best experts and pay for top results.
advice_items.summary_zh: 富豪不硬拼低价，花钱请顶尖人才解决

advice_items.quote: the magic you're looking for is in the work you're avoiding
advice_items.summary_en: Stop avoiding hard tasks—the breakthrough you want lies in the work you are putting off.
advice_items.summary_zh: 你寻找的奇迹就藏在你逃避的工作里

advice_items.canonical_tag: OTHER:Focus on Gratitude & What You Control
advice_items.quote: focus what you have versus what you don't have... focus on today and the future versus the past... focus on what you can control versus what you can't control
advice_items.summary_en: Focus on what you have, the present and future, and only the things within your control.
advice_items.summary_zh: 聚焦已有资源、当下未来及可控之事

guests.first_money_or_break: 深耕蓝领家居服务行业（车库门维修安装 A1 Garage Door Service）二十年，靠长期积累、规模采购与精细化运营将公司做到年营收2.4亿美元。
recommended_books_or_mentors: Think and Grow Rich by Napoleon Hill
Buy Back Your Time by Dan Martell
guests.zero_start_advice: 选择蓝领家居服务等传统现金流行业并长期深耕；通过阅读经典书籍和雇佣顶尖专家买回时间以产生复利效应；专注于当下与未来以及自己能控制的事情。

advice_items.quote: how old were you when you became a millionaire 26... well you know I learned how to sell
advice_items.summary_en: Learn how to sell early—mastering sales is a direct path to becoming a millionaire.
advice_items.summary_zh: 学习销售技能是创造百万财富的起点

advice_items.quote: a book by Daniel Pink it's called To Sell Is Human... it really talks about how buying behaviors and consumers have radically changed
advice_items.summary_en: Study modern books like Daniel Pink's To Sell Is Human to understand how buyer behavior has evolved.
advice_items.summary_zh: 紧跟现代消费心理，研究新销售理念

advice_items.canonical_tag: Solve Real Pain Points & Deliver Value
advice_items.quote: people don't really buy from people they like they buy from people or companies they trust can get them the best result
advice_items.summary_en: Build trust that you can deliver the best result rather than relying solely on likability.
advice_items.summary_zh: 客户只向信任能带来最佳结果的人买单

advice_items.quote: God feeds the birds but he doesn't drop worms in their nest... most people they're all afraid they never do anything so just go out and do something
advice_items.summary_en: Stop letting fear keep you passive—take agency and go take action to help people.
advice_items.summary_zh: 机会就在眼前，克服恐惧立刻去行动

advice_items.quote: you got to be a thousand percent committed... you can't be flaky... they wake up at a certain time they go through a certain day-to-day routine
advice_items.summary_en: Be 1,000% committed and stick to a disciplined daily routine with zero flakiness.
advice_items.summary_zh: 杜绝敷衍摇摆，保持百分百承诺与自律

advice_items.quote: develop the right skills... your skill level can take you to levels that most people don't get cause they don't put in the time to learn the skill level
advice_items.summary_en: Put in the dedicated time to build high-value skills that separate you from the average person.
advice_items.summary_zh: 投入时间打磨高价值技能以突破层级

advice_items.quote: building a culture like building a company where people want to be around and they have that same drive... we share that common goal
advice_items.summary_en: Build a driven company culture where sales, operations, and marketing unite around a shared mission.
advice_items.summary_zh: 打造使命一致、互相驱动的团队文化

guests.first_money_or_break: 早年通过学习销售在26岁成为百万富翁，2018年底创业，五年多时间将公司年营收做到近3400万美元。
recommended_books_or_mentors: To Sell Is Human by Daniel Pink
guests.wealth_detail: Became a millionaire at 26; company revenue just under $34M/yr
guests.zero_start_advice: 保持百分之百的承诺与日常自律，绝不敷衍摇摆；花时间打磨高价值核心技能；靠信任与过硬结果赢得客户，并打造共同使命感的公司文化。

advice_items.quote: sales and leadership will get you rich if you want to get rich you get great at sales you become a great leader you'll dominate everybody
advice_items.summary_en: Become great at both sales and leadership to dominate your market and get rich.
advice_items.summary_zh: 精通销售与领导力就能主宰财富与竞争

advice_items.quote: it's a penny a day doubled every day for 30 days... it took me a year to get to a million followers it took me 90 days to get to my next million... it's a compound effect
advice_items.summary_en: Stay consistent through slow beginnings because business and audience growth accelerate via compounding.
advice_items.summary_zh: 利用复利效应实现营收与流量指数增长

advice_items.canonical_tag: Choose the Right Industry / Big Market
advice_items.quote: lowest barrier of entry... what does it cost to get in sales zero... you can get in sales and you can make 500 grand a year
advice_items.summary_en: Choose a vehicle like sales with zero barrier to entry and immediate six-to-seven-figure earning upside.
advice_items.summary_zh: 选择零门槛且回报无上限的销售赛道

advice_items.quote: broken people are the most dangerous... when the pain overrides the fear of change people change... without a test there's no testimony
advice_items.summary_en: Use rock-bottom pain and adversity as fuel to bounce back higher and build your testimony.
advice_items.summary_zh: 把谷底痛苦化作反弹动力与成长见证

advice_items.quote: I care more about my clients than they care about themselves... be where your feet are... take care of your clients better than they've ever been taken care of
advice_items.summary_en: Give clients your undivided presence and care more about their outcomes than anyone else ever has.
advice_items.summary_zh: 比客户更关心其利益，全神贯注服务

advice_items.quote: if you treat something like it's the beginning there'll never be an end... I never get exhausted it never gets burned out... whoever's the hungriest wins
advice_items.summary_en: Keep day-one hunger and excitement for your craft so you never burn out and always out-hustle competitors.
advice_items.summary_zh: 永远像第一天般饥渴热爱，永不倦怠

advice_items.quote: everybody's built for it if you can just believe in you and no one else believes in you that's enough
advice_items.summary_en: Reject the lie that only a few are built for success—believing in yourself is enough.
advice_items.summary_zh: 即便无人看好也要坚定相信自己

advice_items.quote: have you ever thought about the unlived life... either get there or die trying but damn sure don't be average never conform
advice_items.summary_en: Have the courage to chase your full potential and unlived life rather than settling for average.
advice_items.summary_zh: 勇敢追求本该活出的人生，拒绝平庸

guests.first_money_or_break: 出身贫寒、在校成绩拿D，19岁进入零门槛的销售行业，第一年赚12.5万美元，第二年22.5万，20岁第三年赚到50万美元，后创办大型销售培训公司（年营收1.6亿美元）。
guests.wealth_detail: $160M revenue last year; $250M goal this year
guests.zero_start_advice: 从零门槛的销售行业切入并掌握销售与领导力；把谷底的痛苦转化为反弹动力；全身心专注于客户并比客户更关心他们的利益；坚信自己、拒绝平庸。
